record.original_question: Let I be a complete intersection in K[x1, ..., xn] generated by homogeneous polynomials all of the same degree d, and suppose the quotient K[x1, ..., xn]/I has the same monomial basis as the monomial complete intersection K[x1, ..., xn]/(x1^d, x2^d, ..., xn^d). Does K[x1, ..., xn]/I satisfy the strong Lefschetz property?

evidence.quote: Question 2.3. Let I ⊆ K[x1, . . . , xn] be a complete intersection generated by homogeneous polynomials of uniform degree d ∈ N. Further assume that K[x1, . . . , xn]/I has the same monomial basis as K[x1, . . . , xn]/(x^d_1, x^d_2, . . . , x^d_n). Does K[x1, . . . , xn]/I satisfy the SLP?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero, and let $R = K[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ be the standard graded polynomial ring. Fix an integer $d \geq 1$, and let $I \subseteq R$ be an ideal generated by $n$ homogeneous polynomials $f_1, \ldots, f_n$, each of degree $d$, such that $I$ is a complete intersection (equivalently, $R/I$ is an artinian $K$-algebra of Krull dimension $0$). Assume further that $R/I$ has the same standard monomial basis (with respect to some fixed monomial order) as the artinian monomial complete intersection $R/(x_1^d, x_2^d, \ldots, x_n^d)$; i.e. the set of monomials not in the initial ideal of $I$ equals $\{x_1^{a_1} \cdots x_n^{a_n} : 0 \leq a_i \leq d-1\}$.

Recall that a graded artinian $K$-algebra $A = \bigoplus_{i=0}^{D} A_i$ is said to have the strong Lefschetz property (SLP) if there exists a linear form $\ell \in A_1$ such that, for every pair of integers $0 \leq i \leq j \leq D$, the multiplication map $\cdot \ell^{j-i} : A_i \to A_j$ has maximal rank (i.e. is either injective or surjective).

Question: Does every such $R/I$ satisfy the strong Lefschetz property?
artifact.status_search_result: The question concerns uniform-degree complete intersections whose quotient shares the monomial basis of a pure-power monomial complete intersection. While monomial complete intersections themselves are known to have the SLP in characteristic zero (Stanley, Watanabe), and recent work (e.g. on monomial almost complete intersections and binary trees of complete intersections with SLP) addresses related cases, no source found resolves this specific question in general. It appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Monomial Almost Complete Intersections and the Strong Lefschetz Property
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates SLP for monomial almost complete intersections; complete classification only in restricted cases.
status_evidence.claim: Related uniform-degree SLP questions are still being studied; no general resolution stated.

status_evidence.title: A binary tree of complete intersections with the strong Lefschetz property
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs families of complete intersections with SLP via deformation.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on SLP for complete intersections, no full answer for uniform-degree case with prescribed monomial basis.
